signin.title: Sign in
signin.subtitle: Presence, wallet, and giving — secured by HCS-U7 cognitive identity.
signin.codeSubtitle: Sent to {phone}. Reading it automatically for the pilot.

home.autoModeToast: Auto mode: night follows Maghrib → Fajr

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.buyMockDisc: Pilot mock: no real backing moves. The ledger entry is recorded locally for the demo.
wallet.buyRealDisc: Emission is backed 1:1 by real reserve received. Each buy creates a reserve ledger entry.
wallet.simulateDisc: The simulate button is an explicit mock - no real payment arrives. It credits 150 HAS after a short delay for the demo.
wallet.redeemDisc: Redemption converts HAS to SAR via a regulated partner. Settlement typically takes 1-2 business days and requires KYC verification on the partner side.
wallet.redeemDisabledDisc: No real banking integration at this stage. The button is disabled in the pilot.
wallet.reverifySendSub: Your last verification has expired. Hold to re-verify before sending HAS.

pay.title: Pay
pay.cameraSimulate: You can still simulate a scan for the demo.
pay.pointCamera: Point the camera at a merchant QR code to pay with HAS.
pay.simulateDisc: The pilot uses a simulate button instead of a real QR decoder. The camera stream is real (requires permission), the decode is not.
pay.splitDisc: Split: 80% to merchant in SAR, 20% retained as HAS.
pay.mockReceiptDisc: Pilot mock ledger: the receipt is recorded locally, not on a real chain. No blockchain confirmation is shown because none exists behind this pilot.
pay.reverifyPaySub: Your last verification has expired. Hold to re-verify before authorising this payment.

give.title: Give
give.intro: Give with intention. Zakat is calculated indicatively — for a definitive ruling, consult the Scholar panel.
give.calcDisc: Indicative calculation at 2.5% on net qualifying assets. The nisab shown is illustrative — not a religious ruling.
give.sadaqahDisc: Your donation amount is private — it is not shown in any shared feed.
give.waqfDisc: A Waqf is a restricted, dedicated account with rules for its beneficiaries. The principal is preserved and only the yield is distributed according to the Waqf terms.
give.waqfPilot: In the pilot, Waqf contribution is informational. No real restricted account is created — this will be available when the full ledger and beneficiary rules are in place.
give.waqfDisabled: Disabled in the pilot — consistent with Redeem, which also requires the full regulated partner integration.
give.reverifyZakatSub: Your last verification has expired. Hold to re-verify before paying Zakat.
give.madhabGoldHanafi: Hanafi: all gold & silver jewelry is zakatable.
give.madhabGoldMajority: Shafi'i/Maliki/Hanbali: personal-use jewelry is exempt. List investment gold under cash/business assets.
give.madhabDebtShafi: Shafi'i: only debts due within 12 months are deductible.
give.madhabDebtMajority: Hanafi/Maliki/Hanbali: all debts with a human creditor are deductible.
give.nisabTypeDisc: Silver nisab is the lower threshold (more conservative). Default recommended.
give.shortTermDebts: Short-term debts / installments due this year (SAR)
give.debtsDisc: Short-term debts are always deductible. Long-term loan balance is deductible for Hanafi/Maliki/Hanbali but not for Shafi'i.

prayer.title: Prayer
prayer.presenceRecordedMsg: Your presence for {prayer} has been recorded for this window.
prayer.checkInOpen: Check-in window is open for {prayer}. Tap below to record your presence. This confirms the authenticated session was present — it does not verify any prayer.
prayer.hcsDisc: HCS-U7 authenticates your identity, never a devotional act. This records that the verified human behind the session was present.
prayer.windowPassed: The check-in window for {prayer} has passed. No retroactive check-in is possible.
prayer.factualRecord: Factual record only — no piety score or judgment.
prayer.journalDisc: Your journal is private. It is stored locally on your device only — never on a blockchain, never exposed elsewhere in the app.
prayer.toastCompassDenied: Compass permission denied — using static bearing
prayer.toastCompassNotSupported: Compass not supported — showing static Qibla bearing
prayer.toastNotVerified: HCS-U7 session not verified — re-verify to record presence
prayer.toastAutoMode: Auto mode: night follows Maghrib → Fajr

chats.title: Chats
chats.aiInitial: Assalamu alaikum! I'm Hasanat AI. I can help with prayer times, your wallet, Zakat, giving, learning, and merchants. I never issue religious rulings — those go to the Scholar panel. How can I help?
chats.scholarInitial: The Scholar panel is here for your religious questions. Send a message and a scholar will respond.
chats.communityYusuf: Yusuf: Wa alaikum salam! Don't forget jumu'ah at 13:15.
chats.communityAisha: Aisha: Jazak Allah khairan for the reminder!
chats.familyFatima: Fatima: Are we still on for iftar tonight?
chats.scholarLast: Send a message and a scholar will respond.
chats.communityLast: Jazak Allah khairan for the reminder!
chats.familyLast: Are we still on for iftar tonight?
chats.qr4: Where can I pay with HAS?
chats.deliveryFailed: Message could not be delivered. Try again.

learn.title: Learn
learn.pointsDisc: Hasanat Points are recognition only — they never represent divine reward, a piety ranking, or spiritual worth. They are a private, non-monetary acknowledgment of your effort, nothing more.

mosques.title: Mosques
mosques.readonlyDisc: Read-only view. Institution wallets require multi-signatory approval for disbursement.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.posDisc: Pilot mock POS data — no real merchant processing behind this view.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Session · limits · settings
profile.name: Ben
profile.hcsDisc: HCS-U7 authenticates the person using the session. If the signature no longer matches, financial functions require re-verification before continuing.
profile.exportCsvSub: Download your full ledger as CSV
profile.exportPdfSub: Download your full ledger as PDF
profile.privacyDisc: Your journal is local-only. No blockchain exposure.
profile.toastCsvExported: CSV exported — your activity statement has been downloaded
profile.toastPdfExported: PDF exported — your activity statement has been downloaded
profile.toastAutoMode: Auto mode: night follows Maghrib → Fajr
profile.notifPrayerRemindersSub: Local reminders at each prayer time — no push server at pilot stage
profile.notifPrayerRemindersPilot: Pilot: local preferences only. No push notification system is active yet.
profile.notifTransactionAlertsSub: Notify on Send / Receive / Pay / Buy
profile.notifDonationAlertsSub: Private confirmation for Zakat / Sadaqah — not shown in any shared feed
profile.notifCheckInReminderSub: Remind if the presence check-in window is about to close
profile.secAppLockSub: Require re-verification after a period of inactivity
profile.secAppLockPilot: Pilot: the inactivity timer preference is saved. Full background lock-screen enforcement is not yet implemented.
profile.secLinkedDeviceSub: This device is bound to your HCS-U7 identity
profile.secSingleDevice: Single device — multi-device pairing is not available at this stage
profile.secSessionTimeoutSub: Minutes before Pay / Send / Zakat require re-verification (1–15)
profile.prayerCalcMethodSub: Affects Fajr & Isha angles used by the solar calculator
profile.prayerMadhabSub: Determines which Asr time is primary — the other remains visible as secondary
profile.helpFaqPlaceholder: FAQ content to be defined with the team. This is a placeholder — not final content.
profile.helpTosPlaceholder: Terms of service — to be validated by a legal advisor before production use. This is a placeholder, not final legal text.
profile.helpPrivacyPlaceholder: Privacy policy — to be validated by a legal advisor before production use. This is a placeholder, not final legal text.
profile.helpAboutText: Hasanat is a pilot-stage devotional wallet app. Identity verification is provided by HCS-U7. The pilot uses a mock ledger — no real value moves until validated. Points are recognition only, never cash.
profile.helpHcsCredit: Authentication provided by HCS-U7 cognitive identity verification.

shield.staleTitle: Last verification is stale — re-verify before sensitive actions

holdToVerify.defaultSubtitle: Press and hold the star. Your cognitive signature is captured on this device and compared to your enrolled profile.
holdToVerify.errorReleased: Released before confirmation. Press and hold again.
holdToVerify.disc: HCS-U7 authenticates an identity, never a devotional act. This confirms you are the verified human behind the session — nothing more. Releasing before confirmation fails the check.
